question: Should OpenClaw accept a public `memorySearch.query.hybrid.temporalDecay.minMultiplier` knob and new memory result score diagnostics as product/API surface for this PR?
rationale: The patch is not just an internal ranking tweak; it expands user config and intended result diagnostics, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Require contract decision before merge
options.body: Keep the PR open but require maintainer-approved config/result semantics, public type updates, path coverage, and real behavior proof before it can merge.

options.title: Narrow to internal ranking fixes
options.body: Ask the contributor to remove the public config and diagnostic fields, preserving only bounded internal improvements that have proof.

options.title: Accept the new surface
options.body: Maintain the new config/diagnostics as intentional public surface and require docs, SDK typing, tests, and live proof to match that decision.

recommendation.title: Require contract decision before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but require maintainer-approved config/result semantics, public type updates, path coverage, and real behavior proof before it can merge.
